summary: Implemented resource-local GenericArtifactContent runtime behavior for the get-only Generic Artifacts Content SDK surface.
details: Added a handwritten read-only client that binds by existing status.status.ocid, verifies content with GetGenericArtifactContent, records opcRequestId, and never stores binary content in status.

Delete now confirms readback or unambiguous not-found before releasing the finalizer, while auth-shaped NotAuthorizedOrNotFound keeps the finalizer; OCI content is left unchanged because this SDK exposes no delete method for the content endpoint.
Covered missing tracked identity, successful readback, no-op reconcile reread, OCI error request IDs, no-target delete, read-only delete cleanup, unambiguous not-found, and ambiguous not-found.
